selection.discovery_queues: Per operator: two consistent plus one rare condition, then up to three other global conditions, maximum twelve. Seeded ties.
selection.final_queues: Up to two conditions per operator, with one consistent and one rare when available; consistency fills an empty rare slot.

protocol.scope: Shared prompt templates across partitions are disclosed. Exact prompt strings are disjoint from the parent, initial confirmation and other stages. These finite tasks do not establish out-of-distribution generalization. Separate raters see frozen descriptions without validation scores or notes. Task loss, baseline defects, repetition, collapse, rare effects and random matches are separate from the stability decision.

candidate_provenance.rule: Force L2 N3420 +9x, reserve two coordinates from layers with edited W2 matrices, then fill by earlier validation nominations. L10 N4198 +3 and L14 N1700 -3 are disclosed parent-validation backfills, not claimed stable discoveries. Held-out scores are not consulted.

protocol.timing_semantics: Prediction index 0 is the last prompt position. Prompt-only includes all prompt tokens; decode-only starts with cached call 1. Window [8,24) and pulse 16 affect those predicted response positions. Exposures after a row finished are excluded.
protocol.operator_units: Clamp and add use original-checkpoint activation maxima. Scale is a dimensionless multiplier. These grids are not equal-amplitude comparisons; report local linearized write norms and actual exposure.

decoding: Greedy BF16 native LFM with original tokenizer/configuration, no weight updates. Every physical batch has an untouched anchor. OOM splits retain anchors. Checkpoint aliases are blinded to reviewers; frozen descriptions contain no previous scores or notes.
